title: Expensive logging or stream formatting
summary: Using iostream formatting, stringstream construction, or full object logging in hot paths.
rationale: Formatting and stream abstractions can create unnecessary allocation and CPU overhead.

detection.notes: Detect std::stringstream, operator<< logging, or full payload logs in loops and request paths.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use structured bounded logs, lazy log evaluation, sampling, and efficient formatting libraries.
remediation.tradeoffs: Debuggability matters; retain targeted diagnostic fields.
